speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you mentioned taking naproxen; does your neck swelling hurt, and have you noticed any difficulty swallowing or breathing?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential and ESR

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the normal CBC and ESR results; these help rule out acute bacterial infection or systemic inflammation. Given the normal labs, has the swelling moved specifically to the side of your neck, or is it centered in the front? Also, do you have any recent history of a sore throat, ear infection, or skin infection nearby?

REQUEST TEST: Thyroid Function Tests (TSH, Free T4, T3)

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for confirming the normal thyroid function and lack of systemic infection signs. To narrow this down, is the swelling firm or soft, and can you feel any distinct pulsations or lymph nodes within it?
